waitlist.welcome:
Waiswa pawaitlist yedu.

Mumwe wedu achaverenga chikumbiro chako ogamuchira account yako munguva pfupi. Tichakutumira message kana wagamuchirwa.

Nekuenderera mberi, unobvuma kugamuchira mameseji kubva kuAuto Tuckshop, kusanganisira ma reminder kana usina kunyora zvawatengesa kwenguva. Nyora stop chero nguva kudzimisa izvi.

Panguva ino tumira imwe message nezita reshop yako.
waitlist.first_message_noted: Tachengeta message yako. Kana account yako yagamuchirwa, tumirazve (kana kuti tichakubatsira kuirekoda ipapo).
waitlist.shop_name_noted:
Tatenda! Taziva zita reshop yako "{shop_name}".

Uchiri pakumirira. Tichaverenga chikumbiro chako munguva pfupi.
waitlist.sale_prompt_shop_name: Izvi zvinoita se sale. Uchakwanisa kurekodha ma sale kana shop yako yabvumidzwa. Kutanga, shop yako inonzi chii? (Kana iri zita reshop yako, ritumire zvakare.)
waitlist.still_pending:
Tatenda ne message yako! Uchiri pakumirira pa waitlist.

Tichaverenga chikumbiro chako munguva pfupi. Tichakutumira message kana wagamuchirwa.
waitlist.rejected: Sorry, hatikwanisi kugamuchira chikumbiro chako. Bata agent wedu kana uchifunga kuti pakanganisika.

approval.welcome:
Makadii! Account yako yagamuchirwa paAuto Tuckshop!

Shop: {company}

Unogona kutumira audio (voice note) kana kunyora zvawatengesa nhasi. Semuenzaniso:

'2 Mazoe $3 rimwe'

'5 chingwa R18 chimwe, 2 shuga R40 imwe'

Unogona kunyora ne USD ($), Rand (R), uye ZiG.

Unogona kuisa mutengesi wenyu nekutumira:
'add assistant +2637812345678'

Nyora *stop* chero nguva kudzimisa ma reminder.

🌐 Dzidza zvakawanda: https://auto-tuck-shop.fly.dev
👥 Joinha WhatsApp yedu: https://chat.whatsapp.com/G2HQ6f4Do3k3s7pLD3pnZI
